title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
summary: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
llm_summary: The article curates the most noteworthy AI agents that can be embedded directly into your texting apps, ranging from all‑purpose personal assistants to specialized bots for family coordination, travel planning, and workplace productivity. It highlights how these agents integrate with everyday messaging platforms, making AI‑driven help instantly accessible without leaving your conversation. This roundup helps tech‑savvy readers discover which AI companions best fit their daily communication needs.
